text.en: This Order may be cited as the Protected Places (No. 2) Order, 2023 and shall commence on the date it is made.

The place specified in the first column of the Schedule, which is more particularly described in the plan specified in the second column thereof deposited in the office of the Surveyor-General, is hereby declared to be a protected place for the purposes of the Act. Authorities

The authorities specified in the third column of the Schedule are from whom permission to enter the protected place is to be received.

SCHEDULE (paragraphs 2 and 3) Place Plan Number Authority Clinical Molecular Diagnostic GT220001 TU Director of Laboratory Laboratory for Infectious Diseases Services Department of Laboratory Services Ministry of Health Chief Scientific Officer, Kampong Bukit Bendera Department of Tutong District Laboratory Services. Made this 18th. day of Syawal, 1444 Hijriah corresponding to the 9th. day of May, 2023.

DATO SERI SETIA A WANG HAJI AHMADDIN BIN HAJI ABDUL RAHMAN Minister of Home Affairs. Dicetak oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan 883510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
